cohort: 350 pregnancies involving a fetus with trisomy 21
finding: Trisomy 21 is associated with a significantly increased risk of preterm birth, small for gestational age, cesarean delivery, and combined perinatal/neonatal mortality.
mod_finding: Trisomy 21 was associated with a cesarean delivery rate of 31.5% compared to 27.1% in the general obstetrical population.
